$sources: ECP 203-2018 Chapter 4: 4.2.1 (γc 1.5, γs 1.15; the block 0.67 fcu/γc over a = 0.8 c; c ≤ 2/3 cb), Chapter 2 (Ec = 4400 √fcu, fctr = 0.6 √fcu), 4.2.1.3 (emin = 0.05 t ≥ 20 mm), 4.3 (short columns Pu = 0.35 fcu Ac + 0.67 fy As), 4.2.2 (shear: qcu = 0.24 √(fcu/γc), qmax = 0.7 √(fcu/γc) ≤ 4 N/mm², qs = qu - 0.5 qcu, the least stirrups, their spacing)
source: ECP 203: the parent's BS 8110 limit state methods (both codes design on the cube strength fcu with 0.67 fcu/γc) with ECP 203's values; the areas not set here (punching, deflection, cracking, cover, anchorage, member limits, columns' additional moments, two-way slabs) stay the parent's BS 8110 rules (VERIFY.md E18).

sources.ultimate.relations: ECP 203: the block 0.67 fcu/γc (alphaCC 0.67, η 1.0) over a = 0.8 c (λ 0.8); Ec = 4400 √fcu; fctr = 0.6 √fcu
sources.ultimate.eccentricity: ECP 203 4.2.1.3: emin = 0.05 t, at least 20 mm (no cap: the parent's 20 mm cap removed)
sources.ultimate.axialShares: ECP 203 4.3: short tied columns Pu = 0.35 fcu Ac + 0.67 fy As
sources.ultimate.neutralAxisLimit: ECP 203 4.2.1: c ≤ (2/3) cb, cb/d = 600 / (600 + fy/γs): 0.42 d for fy 400 MPa (written as (1 - k1)/k2 with k1 0.58, k2 1.0; 0.44 d for fy 360)
sources.shear.tauC: ECP 203 4.2.2: qcu = 0.24 √(fcu/γc) of beams; with stirrups qs = qu - 0.5 qcu: the method's τc holds 0.5 qcu = 0.12 √(fcu/1.5) (exact for members with stirrups; on the safe side for members without, which ECP 203 lets carry qcu)
sources.shear.minStirrupStress: ECP 203 4.2.2: Ast,min = 0.4 b s / fy (Asv fy/(b s) ≥ 0.4, i.e. 0.35 with fy/γs; check)
sources.shear.spacing: ECP 203 4.2.2: stirrups at most 200 mm and d/2 apart (check)
